title: ESQET Axiom 2: The Non-Orientable Vacuum Manifold (S³ × S¹)/ℤ₂
description: The vacuum manifold is the non-orientable quotient (S³ × S¹)/ℤ₂ with ℤ₂ action (g,θ) ∼ (-g, θ+π). This topology forces meron action = 4π²/g² (half the instanton) and universal loop factor = 1/(8π²). Both are topologically protected by non-trivial first Stiefel-Whitney class w₁ ≠ 0.
